facts.big: We need some… · Do we have any…?
facts.label: Lista de compras
facts.sub: Pergunte What do we need? Diga We need some milk and some eggs. Pergunte Do we have any bread? Responda We don’t have any. Pergunte How many apples? e combine Who goes to the supermarket?

facts.label: A lista
facts.sub: Antes de ir ao mercado, olhe a geladeira e escreva o que falta. Uma lista evita compras desnecessárias e ajuda a esquecer menos coisas.

facts.label: Some e any
facts.sub: Use some em frases afirmativas, como We need some milk, e any em perguntas e negativas, como Do we have any bread? e We don’t have any.

pages.title: A paper list · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Friday night in a small kitchen in Portland. Dina opens the fridge and looks inside. There is only a little milk and one egg. Her roommate Sam sits at the table with a pen. He has a piece of paper in front of him. They decide to make a grocery list.
“Sam, let’s make a list. What do we need?” says Sam. “We need some milk and some eggs.” says Sam. “Okay. Do we have any bread?” says Sam.
